Contribution to EuroVis 2012

Amir Semmo is presenting a paper on "Interactive Visualization of Generalized 3D City Models using Level-of-AbstractionTransitions" by himself, Matthias Trapp, Jan Eric Kyprianidis, and Jürgen Döllner at EuroVis 2012 in Vienna on June, 6, 2012.
